subject: humanities
passage: The Louvre in Paris first opened as a public museum in 1793, during the French Revolution. Today, ______ collection holds hundreds of thousands of objects, so only a small fraction of them can be displayed at any one time.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The blank must show that the collection belongs to the Louvre, a single museum. The possessive form of "it" is "its," with no apostrophe.
explanation.A: Incorrect. "It's" is a contraction of "it is" or "it has"; "it is collection" makes no sense.
explanation.B: Incorrect. "Their" is plural, but it refers to the Louvre, which is singular.
explanation.C: Correct. "Its" is the singular possessive pronoun, showing the collection belongs to the Louvre.
explanation.D: Incorrect. "Its'" is not a word in Standard English; the possessive "its" never takes an apostrophe.

checks.note: Best fit on the text alone.
